title: SmartAlarm canonical event envelope baseline
$comment: Legacy envelope preserved; physical namespace uses typed payloads. Runtime verifies source, tenant, scope, state transition and evidence. Schema validation cannot establish physical completion.

PhysicalImpairmentChanged.description: Canonical FRD impairment lifecycle. Expiry without verified restoration stays restoration_pending and escalates; approval and restoration evidence are verified at runtime.

RescueEquipmentMissionUpdated.description: Canonical FRD rescue-equipment mission lifecycle. Local operator acceptance is distinct from approval and physical completion; completed requires outcome evidence.

x-runtime-invariants: Bind tenant/region/site from verified identity; compare payload and envelope scope.
Resolve exact accepted model/firmware/gateway/license/point-map/cause-effect; observe-only or console-only bindings cannot actuate.
Match expected_version and If-Match, active revisions, source freshness and signed target/parameter approval digest.
Resolve parameters against approved capability schema and units; enforce expires_at against current server time and capability TTL.
Recheck local mode, impairment, interlocks and feedback at server and edge. Local protection/manual controls remain autonomous.
No LLM may approve, configure or issue physical commands.
Timeout after send becomes UNKNOWN absent proof; no blind retry; fence old writer and reconcile ledger.
Verify evidence ownership, authenticity, signers and physical completion criterion; schema-valid references are not evidence by themselves.
FAT/SAT must bind actual exact configuration; simulator cannot establish field_accepted.
Point-map IDs/raw addresses must be unique within binding and match accepted unit/type semantics.
Envelope tenantid equals verified data.tenant_id; mode agrees with authorized actual/exercise/test context.
Validate aggregate transitions and increasing versions; preserve UNKNOWN provenance after reconciliation.
